from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath
import datetime, hashlib, json, os, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tarfile, time
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SETUP = json.loads((HERE/'setup.json').read_text())
WORK = Path(SETUP['workspace'])
ORIGINAL = Path('/Users/aaravsinha/predictive-grid-cells-rl')
ARCHIVES = ORIGINAL/'results/nonlinear_ring_release/archives'
PYTHON = '/opt/anaconda3/bin/python'
COMMIT = SETUP['source_commit']
RELEASE = ORIGINAL/'results/nonlinear_ring_release'
START = time.monotonic()

def sha(path):
    h=hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open('rb') as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda:stream.read(1024*1024),b''):h.update(block)
    return h.hexdigest()

def command(argv):
    began=time.monotonic()
    result=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=WORK,env=dict(os.environ,PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1'),capture_output=True,text=True)
    record=dict(argv=argv,cwd=str(WORK),exit_code=result.returncode,
                seconds=time.monotonic()-began,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr)
    assert result.returncode==0,record
    return record

def canonical_svg(data):
    root=ET.fromstring(data)
    for parent in root.iter():
        for child in list(parent):
            if child.tag.endswith('}date'):parent.remove(child)
    ids={node.attrib['id']:f'id{n}' for n,node in enumerate(root.iter()) if 'id' in node.attrib}
    for node in root.iter():
        for key,value in list(node.attrib.items()):
            if key=='id':node.attrib[key]=ids[value]
            elif key.endswith('}href') or key=='href':
                if value.startswith('#') and value[1:] in ids:node.attrib[key]='#'+ids[value[1:]]
            elif 'url(#' in value:
                node.attrib[key]=re.sub(r'url\(#([^)]*)\)',lambda m:'url(#'+ids[m.group(1)]+')',value)
    return ET.tostring(root,encoding='utf-8')

def canonical_pdf(data):
    return re.sub(rb'/(CreationDate|ModDate)\s*\([^)]*\)',rb'/\1 (NORMALIZED_DATE)',data)

def pulse(stage,**values):
    print(json.dumps(dict(stage=stage,**values)),flush=True)

proof=dict(scope='Standalone archive extraction and bounded report regeneration only; no scientific experiments, training, or cloud actions.',
           source_commit=COMMIT,started_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
           worktree=SETUP,commands=[],procedure_source_sha256=sha(__file__),procedure_source=Path(__file__).read_text())
assert subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=WORK,text=True).strip()==COMMIT
manifest=json.loads((ARCHIVES/'manifest.json').read_text())
index=json.loads((ARCHIVES/'index.json').read_text())
assert manifest['source_commit']==index['source_commit']==COMMIT
proof['manifest_sha256']=sha(ARCHIVES/'manifest.json')
proof['index_sha256']=sha(ARCHIVES/'index.json')
assert proof['manifest_sha256']==index['manifest_sha256']
proof['commands'].append(command([PYTHON,'scripts/package_nonlinear_ring_outputs.py','--verify-release','--out',str(ARCHIVES)]))
pulse('packaged_verifier_passed',parts=len(index['parts']))

expected={r['path']:r for r in manifest['files']}
assert len(expected)==len(manifest['files'])
seen=set();parts=[]
embedded='results/nonlinear_ring_release/manifest.json'
for part in index['parts']:
    archive_path=ARCHIVES/part['path']
    assert archive_path.stat().st_size==part['bytes'] and sha(archive_path)==part['sha256']
    local=set()
    with tarfile.open(archive_path,'r:gz') as archive:
        for member in archive:
            rel=PurePosixPath(member.name)
            assert rel.parts and not rel.is_absolute() and '..' not in rel.parts and '.git' not in rel.parts
            assert rel.as_posix()==member.name and '\\' not in member.name and '\0' not in member.name
            assert member.isfile() and member.name not in local
            local.add(member.name)
            assert member.name==embedded or member.name in part['members']
            assert (member.uid,member.gid,member.mtime,member.mode)==(0,0,0,0o644)
            target=WORK
            for element in rel.parts[:-1]:
                target/=element
                assert not target.is_symlink()
                target.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
            target/=rel.name
            assert not target.is_symlink()
            record=dict(bytes=(ARCHIVES/'manifest.json').stat().st_size,sha256=proof['manifest_sha256']) if member.name==embedded else expected[member.name]
            assert member.size==record['bytes']
            h=hashlib.sha256();size=0
            with archive.extractfile(member) as source,target.open('wb') as destination:
                for block in iter(lambda:source.read(1024*1024),b''):
                    destination.write(block);h.update(block);size+=len(block)
            assert size==record['bytes'] and h.hexdigest()==record['sha256']
            if member.name!=embedded:
                assert member.name not in seen
                seen.add(member.name)
    assert local==set(part['members'])|{embedded}
    parts.append(dict(path=part['path'],bytes=part['bytes'],sha256=part['sha256'],verified_members=len(local)))
    pulse('extracted_part',path=part['path'],members=len(local))
assert seen==set(expected)
for name,row in expected.items():
    assert (WORK/name).stat().st_size==row['bytes'] and sha(WORK/name)==row['sha256'],name
proof['extraction']=dict(parts=parts,unique_payload_members=len(seen),embedded_manifests=len(parts),
    uncompressed_payload_bytes=sum(row['bytes'] for row in expected.values()),
    every_member_stream_hash_verified=True,every_extracted_file_readback_hash_verified=True,
    symlinks_special_files_traversal_duplicates_rejected=True,normalized_metadata_verified=True)
for name in manifest['source_files']:
    committed=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',f'{COMMIT}:{name}'],cwd=WORK)
    assert hashlib.sha256(committed).hexdigest()==expected[name]['sha256']==sha(WORK/name),name
proof['source_integrity_before_reports']=dict(commit_matches=True,source_files=len(manifest['source_files']),all_hashes_match=True)
pulse('complete_extraction_verified',files=len(expected),source_files=len(manifest['source_files']))

reports=[
 ('scripts/plot_nonlinear_ring_search_summary.py',[
  'results/ring_nonlinear_design/predictive_steering_values.json',
  *['results/ring_nonlinear_design/predictive_steering.'+ext for ext in ('png','pdf','svg')]],
  ['results/native_movement_pulses/report/summary.json']),
 ('scripts/report_native_movement_cycles.py',[
  'results/native_movement_cycles/census_report.json','results/native_movement_cycles/README.md',
  *['results/native_movement_cycles/native_turn_census.'+ext for ext in ('png','pdf','svg')]],
  [f'results/native_movement_cycles/{c}_s{s}/{name}.json' for c in ('gc100','pgc33') for s in (1,2) for name in ('summary','census')]),
 ('scripts/lstm_module_phase_torus_report.py',[
  'results/lstm_module_phase_torus/aggregate.json',
  *['results/lstm_module_phase_torus/module_phase_torus_screen.'+ext for ext in ('png','pdf')]],
  ['results/lstm_module_phase_torus/summary.json']),
 ('scripts/lstm_module_all_phase_control_report.py',[
  'results/lstm_module_all_phase_control/aggregate.json',
  *['results/lstm_module_all_phase_control/all_phase_memory_control.'+ext for ext in ('png','pdf')]],
  ['results/lstm_module_all_phase_control/summary.json'])]
target_names={n for _,names,_ in reports for n in names}
originals={name:(WORK/name).read_bytes() for name in target_names}
proof['report_input_inventory']=[];proof['reports']=[]
for script,targets,inputs in reports:
    assert script in expected
    for name in inputs:
        assert name in expected and sha(WORK/name)==expected[name]['sha256']
        proof['report_input_inventory'].append(dict(path=name,sha256=expected[name]['sha256']))
    proof['commands'].append(command([PYTHON,script]))
    comparison=[]
    for name in targets:
        before,after=originals[name],(WORK/name).read_bytes()
        row=dict(path=name,archived_sha256=expected[name]['sha256'],regenerated_sha256=sha(WORK/name),
                 bytes_identical=before==after)
        assert hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest()==row['archived_sha256']
        suffix=Path(name).suffix
        if suffix=='.json':
            row['numerical_and_structural_json_identical']=json.loads(before)==json.loads(after)
            assert row['numerical_and_structural_json_identical']
        elif suffix=='.svg':
            a,b=canonical_svg(before),canonical_svg(after)
            row.update(canonicalization='Remove date element; consistently relabel element IDs and their href/url references only.',
                canonical_archived_sha256=hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),canonical_regenerated_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
                canonical_content_identical=a==b)
            assert a==b,name
        elif suffix=='.pdf':
            a,b=canonical_pdf(before),canonical_pdf(after)
            row.update(canonicalization='Normalize PDF CreationDate and ModDate fields only.',
                archived_dates=[x.decode() for x in re.findall(rb'/(?:CreationDate|ModDate)\s*\([^)]*\)',before)],
                regenerated_dates=[x.decode() for x in re.findall(rb'/(?:CreationDate|ModDate)\s*\([^)]*\)',after)],
                canonical_archived_sha256=hashlib.sha256(a).hexdigest(),canonical_regenerated_sha256=hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),
                canonical_content_identical=a==b)
            assert a==b,name
        else:
            assert before==after,name
        comparison.append(row)
    proof['reports'].append(dict(script=script,outputs=comparison))
    pulse('report_reproduced',script=script,outputs=len(comparison),byte_identical=sum(r['bytes_identical'] for r in comparison))

for name,row in expected.items():
    assert sha(ORIGINAL/name)==row['sha256'],f'Original archive input changed: {name}'
    if name not in target_names:assert sha(WORK/name)==row['sha256'],f'Unexpected reproduction mutation: {name}'
proof['final_integrity']=dict(original_workspace_archived_inputs_unchanged=True,
    checked_original_files=len(expected),all_nonreport_checkout_inputs_unchanged=True,
    checked_nonreport_files=len(expected)-len(target_names),all_source_files_unchanged=True)
proof['success']=True
proof['finished_utc']=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
proof['elapsed_seconds']=time.monotonic()-START
(RELEASE/'reproduction_proof.json').write_text(json.dumps(proof,indent=2)+'\n')
pulse('proof_complete',reports=len(reports),artifacts=len(target_names),seconds=proof['elapsed_seconds'])
